title: Sagler Mortar and Pestle Set - Small Grinding Bowl Container for Guacamole, Spices, Salsa, Pesto, Herbs - Best Mortar and Pestle Spice and Pills Crusher Set, Holds Up to 2.5oz - 3.75x2’’, Marble Gray
description:
About this item
Handy Kitchen Tool - Enjoy the rich flavors of fresh ground spices, paste, or herbs with our grinder mortar pestle set. At 3.75x2”, the stone grinder bowl can hold up to 2.5oz of wet or dry ingredients.
Crafted to Last - Made of solid marble stone, our molcajete bowl won’t easily break or crack even with frequent use. The spice crusher bowl's interior is unpolished and rough for better grinding.
Beautiful Pill Crusher Set - The stone mortar and pestle are all white with gray accents and a smooth outer finish. This grinder set for spice will look gorgeous on your countertop or kitchen shelf.
Versatile, Easy To Use - Crush ingredients like garlic and ginger using circular motions and firm pressure. Crack seeds and nuts, add some oil, and grind them into a fine paste. Pulverize large pills into powder!
Effortless Cleaning - After use, rinse the marble mortar and pestle with a sponge soaked thoroughly in warm water and let them dry. The guacamole bowl molcajete won’t harbor stains or odors.

reviews_1s:
I'm just starting out in herbalism and I'm on a budget so I thought this would be good instead of the porous stone ones. It was a big mistake. It doesn't grind, it just mashes things. And I've only had it for two weeks and it's already chipped. 😩 I really want my money back.I do not recommend this for food items or pills, as the stone constantly sheds a white powder when in use. I don’t want the chemicals and possibly lead in my food. I have washed this thoroughly but it continues to shed white powder.The pestle broke in half on me on the third use. I never dropped it or used it for anything inappropriate. I notified the company and their reply was basically, "Too bad for you. The only warranty we offer is Amazon's 30-day money back guarantee." In other words, there is no warranty.

I should have looked at more of the low ratings. Most of them are for this very same problem.I had to return this item because the pestle was broken. Also, the bowl was dusty and couldn’t be wiped clean. Not a satisfactory product by any meansThe mortar arrived crushed it would be impossible to remove it from the box.
The pestle is intact but useless without the mortal Will returnThis product is CHEAPLY MADE. I threw it in the trash can. Very disappointedSmaller than I realized and after washed and dried and used , chalky substance was coming off as I used it so never used again.I bought this and in less than 30 days had to return for a replacement due to the bottom becoming smooth. It grinds to white powder. Got a replacement with same results. Returned and was charged a restocking fee because their product was defective!I certainly wish it would have lasted longer than 4 months!The mortar is sturdy & seems of decent quality. However, anything that’s placed in the mortar will pick up the powdery residue that’s constantly within the material & don’t know if it’s safe for mashing herbs or anything edible :/
